name: Golf Course Road
shortDescription: Golf Course Road, Gurugram is one of the most premium and sought-after residential and commercial corridors in Gurugram.
longDescription: Golf Course Road, Gurugram is one of the most premium and sought-after residential and commercial corridors in Gurugram. Known for its luxury apartments, upscale developments, modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity and proximity to major business hubs, the area attracts homebuyers, investors and corporate professionals. Golf Course Road offers easy access to Golf Course Extension Road, MG Road, NH-48, Cyber City and key commercial destinations. The locality features reputed residential projects, premium retail spaces, schools, hospitals, restaurants and lifestyle amenities, making it an attractive destination for luxury living and real estate investment in Gurugram.
